Ivy (Finance): Heads-up: Vendor 'GeoStream' invoiced us with UK VAT on a payment for usage credits (INV-GS-2024-11). They attached a W-9 and claim US status but still charged VAT. Can we hold payment until we sort tax treatment? cc @Sam Tax @Liam Legal
PaymentBot: Invoice INV-GS-2024-11 uploaded by @GeoStream total: $12,000 (VAT $2,400). File: INV-GS-2024-11.pdf
Sam Tax: Quick note: W-9 indicates US person for US withholding, but VAT is a separate issue. If GeoStream is supplying from UK/established in UK they may charge VAT. Need supplier country, VAT reg or proof of tax residency. If they're US but have a UK branch VAT could be valid.
Noah (Vendor Ops): Vendor replied: "We're US-headquartered but operate through GeoStream UK Ltd (GB reg). We attached a W-9 by mistake. Uploaded new doc: UK VAT GB11223344 and a scanned UK company reg."
Liam Legal: Ask for signed reissued invoice showing the correct supplier entity (GeoStream UK Ltd) or GeoStream Inc. If UK entity supplied, VAT may be valid. If US entity supplied, they should not charge UK VAT for B2B. Also request evidence of VAT remittance to HMRC if charged.
Sam Tax: Action items: 1) VIES check on GB11223344. 2) Request either reissue from GeoStream UK Ltd (if they were the supplier) or reissue without VAT if US entity supplied. 3) If UK entity charged VAT but it's actually an agent scenario, ask for agency agreement + supporting docs.
Ivy (Finance): Putting INV-GS-2024-11 on hold. SLA to vendor: 3 business days to reissue or refund VAT and provide remittance proof. Logging in refunds tracker.
Noah (Vendor Ops): Sent vendor message asking for reissued invoice naming the supplier entity and attaching VAT remittance evidence or confirmation of refund.
Sam Tax: VIES lookup pending. I'll update when I have confirmation.
PaymentBot: Payment hold recorded: PH-174555-01 for INV-GS-2024-11.
Ivy (Finance): Thanks all. Will only process credit/refund once corrected invoice or proof of refund is uploaded. Closing when bank feed shows adjustment. :white_check_mark:
